resolved_issues: The subject-level train/test leakage present in the earlier implementation was resolved by replacing the random trial split with a Leave-One-Subject-Out style split.
The previous runtime failure caused by reducing a 1-dimensional similarity tensor along a nonexistent dimension was eliminated.
The previous invalid contrastive formulation was replaced with a symmetric InfoNCE-style objective based on a pairwise similarity matrix.
new_issues: prepare_eeg_data() resets the global random number generator via torch.manual_seed(42), which is a reproducibility/design concern but not a blocking correctness issue.
The temporal mean pooling before InfoNCE is an explicit modeling assumption that discards temporal information, but it is not a correctness or runtime defect.
summary: The submitted diff resolves all previously identified blocking issues. No blocking regressions were introduced. The remaining observations are non-blocking design considerations rather than correctness, runtime, or methodological failures. Based on the provided diff, it is safe to accept.
